references.text: Psalm 66:1-2 encourages telling of God's deeds, which mirrors the call in Mark 5:19 to tell what the Lord has done.
In John 8:38-39 a man is healed by Jesus and tells about it, paralleling the man in Mark 5:19 who is also asked to share about his healing.
Matthew 9:30-31 describes how those healed by Jesus could not keep from speaking about it, similar to the instruction given in Mark 5:19.
Acts 1:8 encourages being witnesses for Jesus, which resonates with the instructions given in Mark 5:19.
